gloss: a bow; a nod of greeting

definitions.gloss: a bow; a nod of greeting; a polite bow
definitions.explanation: A single bow made as a greeting, expression of thanks, or show of respect. Describes a brief, formal bowing gesture.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{軽|かる}く{一礼|いちれい}した。
{舞台|ぶたい}に{上|あ}がる{前|まえ}に{客席|きゃくせき}に{向|む}かって{一礼|いちれい}した。
examples.english: Before going on stage, I bowed to the audience.

examples.japanese: {面接官|めんせつかん}に{一礼|いちれい}してから{席|せき}に{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: I bowed to the interviewer and then took my seat.

notes:
COMPOSITION:
{一|いち} (one) + {礼|れい} (bow, courtesy). Literally "one bow."

GRAMMAR:
{一礼|いちれい}する is used as a する verb meaning "to bow once" or "to give a bow."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一礼|いちれい}する (to bow)
- {軽|かる}く{一礼|いちれい}する (to give a slight bow)
- {深|ふか}く{一礼|いちれい}する (to bow deeply)
- {丁寧|ていねい}に{一礼|いちれい}する (to bow politely)
